## Workflow E — Review, Approval & Ownership

Server-only backend for the authenticated Vercel API. Every webhook rejects requests unless `x-n8n-proxy-secret` matches `N8N_PROXY_SECRET`.

### GET /webhook/review
Reads `user`, `prescriptions`, source `nudges`, delivery history, and canonical `weekly_schedule` rows. The recurring editor must read only active weekly schedule rows after migration.

### POST /webhook/approve
Idempotently replaces a patient's canonical weekly schedule, cancels removed future unsent deliveries, preserves sent history, and materializes deterministic dated nudge rows.

### POST /webhook/assign-patient
Updates the canonical `user.doctor_id` after the Vercel API has verified administrator access.

Assign the Google Sheets OAuth2 credential to every Sheets node. Add the `doctor_id` header to the user tab and create the `weekly_schedule` tab with the documented headers before activating this workflow.
